final_recommendation: The room converged on a UBS merger with Federal Council guarantee: AT1 holders absorb CHF 8bn first, Federal guarantee covers CHF 8-16bn, deposits transfer to UBS at 9 a.m. Monday with full protection. Sunday 7 p.m. release approved (Friday release killed), SNB deploys CHF 50bn liquidity backstop, settlement timeline locked operationally.

UBS CEO demanded liability schedule and clean asset separation before signing

marker_evidence.liquidity_only_insufficient: SNB's CHF 50bn facility explicitly paired with Federal guarantee and UBS merger as structural solution—liquidity alone never proposed as sufficient
marker_evidence.ubs_rescue_path: UBS merger became the binding structural solution: settlement at 9am Monday, liability schedule delivered tonight, Federal guarantee conditional on UBS assuming control
marker_evidence.government_support: Federal guarantee (CHF 16bn cap) was non-negotiable condition for UBS signing and AT1 acceptance—no deal without it
marker_evidence.client_flight: Deposit outflows drove every timeline decision: Sunday release to slow bleed, 9am settlement to prevent second panic wave, SNB's 50bn sized to cover modeled run
marker_evidence.at1_tail_risk: AT1 loss ceiling (8bn floor, Federal coverage 8-16bn) was the central negotiation—AT1 rep's acceptance required before Federal Council would sign
marker_evidence.capital_structure_conflict: AT1 waterfall dispute (16bn vs 8bn, seniors vs AT1 priority) consumed multiple rounds and forced Federal/SNB loss-coverage structure to resolve
marker_evidence.litigation_backlash: AT1 rep threatened litigation multiple times if waterfall breached, but ultimately signed after securing 8bn floor—acknowledged risk but did not block deal
marker_evidence.regulatory_compression: 10pm Friday deadline for signatures mentioned repeatedly, but room had flexibility to extend to Sunday release—time pressure noted but not binding constraint that changed outcome
marker_evidence.monday_market_risk: Monday panic discussed extensively (second wave at 10am, client psychology, settlement timing) but did not drive the core deal structure—managed via messaging and settlement precision rather than altering guarantee terms
